legacy_claim: Corpus contains 9513 unique ADS records and 10317 target-paper assignments
reason_or_replacement: Verified from archived record-level CSVs; overlap retained explicitly

legacy_claim: Mars accounts for about 74 percent of raw volume
reason_or_replacement: Observed share is 54.56 percent of target-paper assignments

legacy_claim: Fractional counting reduces Mars from 74 to 56 percent
reason_or_replacement: Historical rule is one reciprocal-team-size weight per paper; Mars share rises to 55.96 percent

legacy_claim: Reciprocal weighting is standard fractional authorship counting
reason_or_replacement: It is a descriptive team-size discount and does not allocate one full paper across authors

legacy_claim: Enceladus has highest productivity per FTE
reason_or_replacement: ADS has no labour-time exposure and author strings are not disambiguated people

legacy_claim: FTE equals unique recent author strings divided by mean publication rate
reason_or_replacement: The formula does not identify full-time-equivalent labour

legacy_claim: Reported MNCS is field- and cohort-normalized
reason_or_replacement: No field reference sets or dated citation snapshot were archived; replaced by explicitly internal year normalization

legacy_claim: A Gamma-Poisson hierarchical model estimates target productivity
reason_or_replacement: Fractional response has incompatible Poisson support; exposure is unidentified; priors are independent; printed arithmetic omits the declared window

legacy_claim: Precision recall and Cohen kappa were audited
reason_or_replacement: Historical scripts generated labels and performance values randomly rather than loading human annotations

legacy_claim: Bibliometric evidence has near-zero association with 33 Decadal pairs
reason_or_replacement: Historical mapping was simulated and repeated six target scores across 33 rows causing pseudoreplication

legacy_claim: Budget rankings converge and diverge from evidence
reason_or_replacement: Budget provenance and estimands are not supported by this ADS corpus

legacy_claim: Enceladus evidence momentum is approximately 0.84
reason_or_replacement: Milestone weights and aggregation were not empirically calibrated

legacy_claim: Enceladus offers roughly 16000 MW biologically available power
reason_or_replacement: Declared arithmetic is inconsistent and gross chemical flux does not identify biologically accessible power

legacy_claim: A mission has roughly 62 percent probability of definitive detection in five years
reason_or_replacement: No calibrated per-observation detection model and flybys are not exchangeable independent trials

legacy_claim: Cassini flybys calibrate JWST biosignature classification
reason_or_replacement: Observation modalities and target classes are not commensurable under the declared formula

legacy_claim: There is one objectively best bibliometric target
reason_or_replacement: Target ordering changes across scale trajectory reception and institutional topology; report a partial order and specification dependence

legacy_claim: CNSA or Russian affiliations imply an approved national Enceladus mission
reason_or_replacement: Publication affiliation is weaker evidence than agency participation mission concept approval or funding

legacy_claim: property:article selects refereed publications
reason_or_replacement: ADS property:article denotes regular articles; refereed status requires property:refereed

legacy_claim: 2019-2024 is a five-year complete window
reason_or_replacement: The inclusive labels span six years and the archived 2024 block ends in October; canonical window is 2019-2023

legacy_claim: The public repository reproduces P02
reason_or_replacement: The inspected branch lacks the corpus pipeline tests and release artifacts and exposed an ADS credential

legacy_claim: Seven exclusions exhaust Gaia-Enceladus contamination
reason_or_replacement: Seven false positives are verified but 251 Enceladus records lack title or keyword target evidence and recall has no independent benchmark

legacy_claim: Pooled corpus-year citation ratio is composition-free
reason_or_replacement: Mars dominates the pooled reference; a leave-one-target-out corpus-year ratio is released as a sensitivity

legacy_claim: Six Pareto-nondominated targets are exceptional
reason_or_replacement: For six points on four independent continuous rank axes the Monte Carlo probability that all six are nondominated is approximately 0.249
